title: Clarity Speech & Language - Practice Videos & More - Videos
channel: Clarity Speech & Language - Practice Videos & More
description: Clarity Speech and Language offers articulation, language, fluency, memory and phonemic awareness practice materials for kids.  With a wide variety of story videos and articulation images, SLPs and parents will appreciate having online materials at their fingertips. This is especially helpful for remote SLPs who do teletherapy.  Kids love using phones, iPads and computers, which makes practicing online more fun for them, and we all know that practice makes perfect!  There are resources for practicing speech sounds, language processing concepts, following directions and memory strategies, and phonemic awareness skills such as phoneme segmentation, rhyming, and phoneme substitution.  As an experienced SLP who has worked many years in the public schools, private practice, and teletherapy, I create materials that are focused on a specific skill and that can be completed in 10 minutes or less.  I hope this helps others who need resources to teach their students or their own children.
